# Security Checklist: Pilot Review Packet and Lifecycle Snapshot

**Purpose**: Validate security, redaction, and safe reviewer-output requirements for SPEC-009D packet artifacts.
**Created**: 2026-05-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are requirements complete for reusing existing SPEC-007 artifact redaction, compaction, hashes, byte counts, previews, and security-scan state instead of adding packet-specific secret handling? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Redaction And Safety]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements complete for excluding raw secret-bearing, quarantined, unsafe-preview, binary non-redactable, and oversized evidence from packet JSON and Markdown output? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Contract §Evidence-state contract]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements complete for carrying artifact metadata including `redaction_status`, `security_scan_status`, `sha256`, `byte_size`, `mime`, `schema_version`, and supersession identity for artifact-backed evidence? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §Packet Artifact]
- [x] CHK004 Are requirements complete for metadata-only quarantined evidence, including explicit exclusion of raw content, preview text, storage URI, and actor identity? [Completeness, Spec §Clarifications, Contract §Evidence-state contract]
- [x] CHK005 Are source-map requirements complete enough to trace security-sensitive evidence claims without copying raw sensitive payloads into the packet? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Clarifications]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Are `redacted`, `quarantined`, `oversized`, `missing`, `malformed`, `superseded`, and `stale` packet-local evidence states clearly separated from existing task-artifact enum semantics? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Data Model §Packet Evidence Entry]
- [x] CHK007 Is preview eligibility clear for secret-bearing or unsafe evidence, including the rule that binary or otherwise non-redactable secret findings expose no preview text? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Contract §Evidence-state contract]
- [x] CHK008 Is publication failure clear for invalid JSON, unsafe storage/display content, or missing identity/sync proof when state would otherwise claim a proven packet? [Clarity, Contract §Failure And Incomplete States]
- [x] CHK009 Are Markdown-output safety requirements explicit for escaping or safely fencing untrusted stored evidence values so generated reviewer Markdown cannot reinterpret evidence as raw HTML, active links, tables, headings, or list structure? [Resolved, Spec §Clarifications, Plan §Redaction And Safety, Contract §Markdown Artifact]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Do security requirements align between the spec, plan, data model, and contract for using existing artifact metadata instead of creating packet-local redaction or security-scan persistence? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Redaction And Safety, Data Model §Packet Evidence Entry, Contract §Evidence-state contract]
- [x] CHK011 Do API inspection requirements keep quarantined artifacts locked through existing `423 artifact_locked` metadata behavior while allowing ordinary redacted artifacts to remain readable without reconstructing pre-redaction content? [Consistency, Contract §Existing API Surface]
- [x] CHK012 Do Markdown and JSON requirements consistently require the same source snapshot and non-contradiction for lifecycle, gate, evidence, deferral, and warning values? [Consistency, Spec §SC-003, Contract §Markdown Artifact]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Are success criteria measurable for source-map coverage on 100% of evidence-backed packet claims without requiring terminal logs or fresh GitHub calls? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK014 Are local-only lookalike rejection criteria measurable when stored GitHub linkage or sync proof is missing? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK015 Are future-state deferral criteria measurable for 100% of requested run-state, claim, retry, sync automation, sandbox, adapter, and harness fields? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario And Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK016 Are requirements defined for compacted latest-error evidence that has only a preview and hash available? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Are requirements defined for missing, malformed, superseded, stale, redacted, quarantined, and oversized evidence without leaking raw sensitive content? [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications, Contract §Failure And Incomplete States]
- [x] CHK018 Are requirements defined for disposable replay evidence that was intentionally cleaned after capture while retained smoke checklist and GitHub sync evidence remain source-map inputs? [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications]

## Re-run Validation

- [x] CHK019 Are Markdown-output safety requirements now explicit that stored evidence-derived strings are untrusted display data even after redaction? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, Contract §Markdown Artifact]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements now clear that evidence-derived Markdown content must be escaped or safely fenced and must not emit raw HTML? [Security/Redaction, Spec §Clarifications, Plan §Redaction And Safety, Contract §Markdown Artifact]
